blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Gabriel Go has stopped reporting for work at the Metropolitan Manila Development Authority (MMDA) as he awaits his appointment as an assistant secretary at the Department of Transportation (DOTr), MMDA Chair Atty. Don Artes said on Wednesday. Artes said the agency had yet to receive Go’s formal resignation letter but had already been informed of his planned transfer by Transportation Secretary Vince Dizon. “Secretary Vince Dizon informed me that Gab would be transferring,” Artes said during a press conference.
